name: Rakibul Islam

wordpress.props: Received props in the Make WordPress Slack

tagline: I break things on purpose, so your users don't.
intro: I've spent 3+ years building automated test frameworks for web, SaaS and API products. Right now I test WordPress and WooCommerce plugins at WPPOOL.
Most days that means Playwright and TypeScript, Dockerized test environments and GitHub Actions pipelines that run on every commit.

status.headline: Open to new roles
status.detail: Remote QA Automation / SDET roles, including teams in Europe.

experience.summary: Playwright (TypeScript) POM frameworks and CI for WordPress/WooCommerce plugins.
bullets: Designed and executed end-to-end manual and automated test suites for WordPress plugins, including FlexOrder, FlexStock, EchoRewards, FlexTable, FormyChat, WP Dark Mode and Jitsi Meet.
Designed reusable Playwright (TypeScript) automation frameworks using the Page Object Model for end-to-end, functional and regression testing.
Automated WooCommerce ↔ Google Sheets synchronization testing by integrating the Google Sheets API and WooCommerce REST API, ensuring bi-directional order and stock accuracy.
Performed API testing to validate endpoints, authentication, data integrity and error handling across plugin integrations.
Integrated automated test workflows into GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for continuous, commit-triggered testing.
Executed regression testing on release-candidate builds and wrote reproducible bug reports to speed up fixes.
Verified cross-browser compatibility, UI responsiveness and internationalization (i18n) across supported plugins.
Created user guides and testing documentation to improve usability and onboarding.

experience.summary: End-to-end, API (Postman) and performance (JMeter) testing for MacroHealthPlus.
bullets: Started with manual testing, finding defects and inconsistencies with a methodical approach.
Performed end-to-end testing of MacroHealthPlus across all modules.
Used Apache JMeter to evaluate performance and stability under various load conditions.
Ran comprehensive API testing in Postman, verifying endpoints, parameters and responses.

experience.summary: Test plans, test cases and first automation scripts in an Agile squad.
bullets: Worked with developers and designers in an Agile, squad-based team on usability, security and quality for new features.
Reviewed design and technical specifications to create test plans and test cases for functional, regression and performance testing.
Wrote automation scripts, executed test scenarios and compiled quality reports.

education.school: Bangladesh University of Business and Technology (BUBT)

achievements.title: Built an end-to-end test automation framework
achievements.detail: Automated 38 end-to-end scenarios across setup, WooCommerce order management and Google Sheets synchronization with Playwright and TypeScript, reaching a 100% pass rate and removing manual regression testing.

achievements.title: Engineered a zero-touch CI/CD pipeline
achievements.detail: A Dockerized GitHub Actions pipeline, triggered on every plugin commit via repository_dispatch, provisions a fresh WordPress + WooCommerce environment and validates the exact pushed version before release.

story: I graduated in Computer Science and Engineering from BUBT in December 2022. The course that shaped me most was Software Testing and Quality Assurance: it taught me that quality has to be built into every stage of development, not only checked at the end.
Since then I've moved from manual testing into automation, and I still enjoy the same thing: finding the scenario nobody thought about, then making sure a test catches it every time.
